create_PoolSubgraph: create a PoolSubgraph to collect and collate sampled subgraphs into block-diagonal adjacency matrices
create_CachedSubgraph: create a CachedSubgraph to cache previously sampled subgraphs for reuse across training epochs
create_OneBatchSubgraph: create a OneBatchSubgraph dataclass holding adjacency, features, labels, and targets for one minibatch
build_MinibatchShallowExtractor: build a MinibatchShallowExtractor to sample and collate graph subgraphs for node or link prediction training
run_MinibatchShallowExtractor_one_batch: run the one_batch method of MinibatchShallowExtractor to prepare one batch of training subgraph data
